summary: P0: Webull confirmation (false-flip) exit left the leg naked - GIPR x2 and IMCC on 2026-09-18 (-8.3%, -18.4%, -9.2% vs Schwab -1.3%/-2.2%), 10-session gap -31.7pp. Reviewed the full runtime diff at 124a1279 and withheld it for L1 (proven in-flight key leak) and L2 (1/2/4 s sleeps inline on the serial tick consumer - my own spec). Re-reviewed 703ada30 on main 6871957a: range-diff of the first five commits is '=' to what I read; read the two new commits in full. Root cause fixed: claim before the first await + identity pop, so the tick consumer and the control loop can no longer both cancel the pair. Release now uses broker_adapter.release_exit_pair_for_close (cancel AND read both children) with a bounded retry inside the 180 s expiry; only two terminal/absent legs or a positively identified broker fill authorise the sell; every other answer, including an unknown code, ends REPROTECTED+PAGED or uncovered+PAGED (one SystemIncident per acct/symbol/row/fill). L1: everything from the in-flight add is inside try/finally - my probe (bound-row read raises once) now shows the key cleared, a second read, and the Webull sell. L2: backoff (0.5, 1.0) and inline_seconds logged on every marker; still inline on the tick path, stated in code, moving it off-path is owned by claude-1. Class D: exactly one corrected market retry, only for a wholly malformed-rejected confirmation close on a Webull account. 165 tests pass with PYTHONPATH on the PR tree; fixtures carry the real Webull request ids/codes from today. Mutations RED, each edit confirmed applied: finally no longer discards the key (1); backoff back to 1/2/4 (2); class D retries any reject (5); unanswerable treated as released (7); budget exhausted returns refused (12); earlier at 124a1279 also claim-before-await, idempotent shortcut, reprotect-without-page, no-retries. One mutation first applied 0 lines (pattern mismatch) and was redone. EXITDONE1 run by me on today's real oms.log + fills: RECURRENCE, live:orb fired=4 sold=1 gap=3, schwab 2/2. NO FLAG: this goes live on the OMS restart. ASSUMED, not proven: re-attaching a full pair while an old leg still works is refused by Webull's share reservation (class A) and pages protection FAILED rather than leaving two stops. Not covered: CW_HARD_STOP / CW_FLOOR / CW_FLIP / overnight flatten still use the old one-try release; in-memory release state across an OMS restart.
